messages.message: Thanks for calling the clinic. This is the virtual assistant. How can I help you today?
Hi, my name is Siobhan Nguyen. I'd like to find out when my next appointment is.
Hi Siobhan, I can help with that. First I need to verify your identity. What is your date of birth? Please give me the month, day and year.
My date of birth is April 3, 1991.
